body: Some good news to share: WHRO came out to see what we're building. Reporter Ashley White spent time with the community and wrote Through 757 Tech, developers and programmers in Hampton Roads find community — a look at why so many of you keep showing up.

The piece covers a lot of ground: HTML Day in August, where about thirty people came out and nearly a dozen walked away with a site they had launched themselves; the Late Night Builders crew that meets after 9 p.m.; and the JavaScript, AI, and cybersecurity meetups that fill the calendar week to week.

Thanks to Ashley and WHRO for the thoughtful coverage, and to Chazona Baum and Paul Chin for talking with them. Mostly, thanks to all of you — the story is about this community, and there is no story without the people who show up.
We are always looking for topic and speaker suggestions — let us know if you have thoughts! Just hit reply, or come find us in Discord.

quote.text: Everybody in this community has been the warmest, most wholesome group of people that I think I've ever met.
